---
title: Contributing
---

The project welcomes contributions. The working agreement lives in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md);
its core rules:

- Branches only: one change per branch, merged by pull request.
- Conventional Commits subjects; signed commits throughout.
- One logical change per PR; the PR body links the `docs/spec.md`
  sections it exercises through GitHub heading anchors.
- **Harness before capability:** the failing test exists first; the PR
  records the RED output verbatim.
- The acceptance suite on every change: `cargo fmt --check`,
  `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`, `cargo test`, and the shared pre-commit
  hook set.

Security-sensitive surfaces — the read-only invariant, the event
schema, the ledger chain, the capture-scope boundaries, the eBPF
capability set — carry extra review rules; see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
and [SECURITY.md](security.qmd).

Report defects the ordinary way in a
[GitHub issue](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/issues/new).
Security issues follow the channels on the [security page](security.qmd).
